label: Bags — handbags, totes, crossbody
note: Authored, never generated. hero_kind is on-body-crop: the hero is a torso-and-hand crop, because a bag needs a body for SCALE — the single thing a standalone product shot cannot convey — but does not need a face. The set deliberately alternates on-body (scale, how it hangs) and product-only (true colour, construction).
preserve_fields: the material, grain, colour and finish
the silhouette and proportions, and the size relative to a hand
the hardware — clasps, feet, rings and zips — and its metal finish
the strap or handle type, length and how it attaches
the stitching colour, density and edge painting
any logo, plaque or embossing exactly as it appears

blocks.keep_onbody: Keep the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its material, colour, silhouette, hardware and strap unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not redraw, restyle, recolour, resize or reposition any panel, hardware element, stitch line or logo. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic.
blocks.tail: {{campaign.grade}}, sharp focus, no motion blur, no extra text or logos.
blocks.no_person: ABSOLUTELY NO human presence: no skin, no hands, no arms, no shoulder, no body. Nothing but the bag.
blocks.product_setup: product photography, no person and no mannequin anywhere in the frame, the bag standing upright and holding its own shape on {{campaign.flatlay_surface}}

prompt: {{ref_roles_sentence}}
Task: produce a studio e-commerce hero photograph of this exact {{category.garment_noun}} CARRIED by a real person, cropped so the bag is the subject.

FRAMING: a three-quarter crop from mid-thigh to mid-chest. NO face and NO head anywhere in the frame. The {{category.garment_noun_short}} is held in one hand at the model's side, hanging naturally at its true length, occupying the centre of the frame with the hand and forearm giving it scale.
Scale is the whole reason this shot is on a body: a bag photographed alone gives a customer no idea how large it is.
STYLING: the model wears {{wardrobe}}, deliberately plain and low-contrast so nothing competes with the bag. {{campaign.accessories_rule}}
SET: {{campaign.set}}, {{campaign.light}}.
{{blocks.must_preserve}}
{{campaign.grade}}, true-to-life material grain, sharp focus throughout, no motion blur.
{{ref_roles_sentence}} {{blocks.keep_onbody}}

Change the pose and framing: the same torso crop, now with the {{category.garment_noun_short}} worn across the body — the strap over one shoulder and across the chest, the bag resting at the hip at its natural drop length. NO face and NO head in frame. Arms relaxed at the sides.
This is the shot that answers where the bag actually sits when worn, which no product shot can.
{{blocks.tail}}
